svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
12 x VL53L5CX ToF + 2 lasers, Observer board
Procedure pending the Rev T+ re-audit of guide Phases 4-11 (graphical-build-guide/WBS.md 1.5.6).
This card shows the Rev T+ architecture only; follow the authority documents named below.
Sensor stations come from the current head and cargo layouts, not the Rev O map.
Observer sensors sit on the board edge.
Class 3B lasers can injure eyes. Never look into the nose aperture with the laser powered.
